# Pixel art

Crisp blocks, deliberate steps, and a playful digital character.

## Use

Use for game-like learning, progress cards, and playful internal campaigns.

## Essential traits

- Square pixel geometry
- Monospace rhythm
- Limited high-contrast palette

## Typography

System monospace with bold short headings; avoid unavailable pixel fonts.

## Layout and surfaces

Stepped frames, square corners, simple block motifs. Hard-edged borders and offset pixel shadows.

## Palette

- background: #182039
- surface: #24304e
- text: #f5f5ff
- muted: #c5cee7
- accent: #ffe49b
- border: #7181aa

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Pixel art to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace with bold short headings; avoid unavailable pixel fonts. Stepped frames, square corners, simple block motifs. Hard-edged borders and offset pixel shadows. Palette: background #182039, surface #24304e, text #f5f5ff, muted #c5cee7, accent #ffe49b, border #7181aa. Essential traits: Square pixel geometry; Monospace rhythm; Limited high-contrast palette. Avoid: Blurred pixel boundaries; Tiny unreadable text; Symbols replacing necessary labels. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
